targets.title: Less is better: When low-value options are valued more highly than high-value options.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a preregistered close replication and extension of Studies 1, 2, and 4 in Hsee (1998).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, we found support for four of the five effects in Hsee (1998), with no support for the fifth effect, which was in the right direction (Table 5). Our extensions resulted in insightful findings. We conclude robust evidence for the less is better effect, with effect size varying when compared to the original, depending on the vignette used. However, there was weaker evidence for the more is better effect, with only Study 2 showing significant support for it.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors frame the overall evidence as four effects supported and one unsupported, and explicitly describe the joint-evaluation Study 4 effect as a failed replication.
